articles.title: NVIDIA RTX Spark PCs Available Today — A New Beginning for Windows PCs
articles.summary: NVIDIA today announced the availability of NVIDIA RTX Spark™ laptops, bringing together RTX graphics and NVIDIA’s full-stack AI platform in slim, premium Windows PCs for accelerated creation, immersive gaming and powerful local AI — rolling out from ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft and MSI.

articles.title: Mercedes-Benz and NVIDIA Expand Strategic Partnership to Advance Safe Highly Automated Driving in the Next Decade
articles.summary: Mercedes-Benz and NVIDIA today announced that they will extend their strategic partnership to advance the next generation of automated driving systems.

articles.title: Volvo Cars and NVIDIA Expand Partnership to Advance Safe Automated Driving
articles.summary: Volvo Cars today announced it is expanding its partnership with NVIDIA to unlock new levels of safety in automated driving technology in future cars from Volvo, building on the companies’ decade-long collaboration.

articles.title: Adobe and NVIDIA Expand Collaboration to Speed Agentic Creation
articles.summary: Adobe (Nasdaq: ADBE), the global technology leader that unleashes creativity, productivity and customer experiences through innovative tools and platforms, and NVIDIA today announced an expansion of their partnership to optimize Adobe’s flagship tools including Adobe Photoshop, Premiere, Substance 3D, Frame.io and Brand Concierge, delivering faster AI-powered creation, production and personalization.

articles.title: NVIDIA and Semiconductor Leaders Advance AI Across Chip Design and Manufacturing for AI-Defined Fabs
articles.summary: NVIDIA today announced semiconductor leaders are adopting NVIDIA CUDA-X™ libraries — including the new NVIDIA cuPotential library, which developers can use to build AI agents that simulate how atoms and molecules interact — to advance AI-defined fabs.

articles.title: NVIDIA Commits $250 Million to Advance UK Agentic Safety and Security Research Over the Next Five Years
articles.summary: NVIDIA today announced a five-year compute donation valued at $250 million to strengthen the United Kingdom’s agentic safety and security research capability.

articles.title: NVIDIA Lands in Europe for GTC Berlin
articles.summary: NVIDIA is in Europe, showcasing the future of technology together with the region’s developers, researchers and industry leaders.
articles.author: NVIDIA Writers

articles.title: NVIDIA and Cisco Introduce New Pluggable Optics Form Factor to Scale AI Factories
articles.summary: NVIDIA and Cisco today announced plans for Ultra-Dense Small Form Factor Pluggable (USFP), a new high-density 400Gb/s-per-lane optical module designed to equip the hardware ecosystem for the next generation of AI factories using pluggable transceivers.

articles.title: Into the Omniverse: How Developers Turn Ideas Into Simulations With Frontier AI Agents
articles.summary: Turning a simulation idea into a working application means assembling assets, connecting physics and rendering, and checking that the scene behaves as intended. Developers are combining frontier AI models with NVIDIA Omniverse libraries to help carry out that work — building applications for exploring scenarios, investigating failures and improving designs.
